author: MiniWarGaming
description:
We put three Admirals together, gave each a fleet and orders, and what happened next was beyond our control.

Welcome to the first episode of our new Battlefleet Gothic Narrative Campaign. Luka invades the Scarus Sector with a Chaos Renegade Fleet. The Imperial Defenders rally around Captain Horatio Star and mount a defence, while the Orks commanded by James are given ships... and hilarity ensues. 

In collaboration and a big thanks to Admiral Turbidious, make sure you check him out for more BFG goodness.
